title: Lodge Raid Coverage: Tom Dwan Enters the Chat
deck: A day after the raid, Tom Dwan jumped into a tense Twitter thread with Brad Owen, Doug Polk, and others — and the story started splitting into two different versions.
author: Shomari Williams
body:
Lodge Card Club Update — Now Tom Dwan Has Entered The Chat
The Lodge Card Club in Round Rock remains closed following Tuesday’s search warrant executed by state police and TABC. The Lodge’s official statement says their attorneys are still working to understand the reasons behind the search, meaning even they don’t fully know why yet.
Now poker legend Tom Dwan has inserted himself into the conversation, with his own separate allegations.
Dwan is claiming he warned Doug Polk years ago about a game integrity vulnerability at The Lodge and that Doug chose not to address it. Dwan has been careful to say he does not believe the TABC raid is connected to that issue, but the timing has the poker world asking questions.
Worth noting, Dwan has also acknowledged personal friction with Doug, so we’re not dealing with a completely neutral party here.
Bottom line: Two separate stories colliding at the worst possible time for The Lodge. The TABC situation is still unresolved. And now there are integrity questions being raised publicly by one of the most respected names in the game.
We’re watching this closely. I’d love to see your comments.
